description: Body of the `check_incremental` action: a query and an optional config to check it against.

incremental_key.description: Output column whose advancing value marks rows as new. Omit to only list candidates.

lookback_seconds.description: How far back before the watermark to re-read each run, to pick up late-arriving data.

unique_key.description: Output columns that identify a row. Must include every GROUP BY column.
